detailed_descriptions.en: Company of Heroes 3: Fire and Steel is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of four Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ skirmish vs AI. US Forces – Heavy Weapons Battlegroup Superior team weapons and halftracks control the battlefield before heavy armor arrives to finish the fight. Requisition .50 cal heavy machine guns or off-map batteries of the devastating Black Dragon howitzer as part of Weapons Team support, or call in the Cavalry, with Assault half-track variants, 3-inch towed Anti-tank guns, and the implacable M26 Pershing heavy tank. Wehrmacht – Terror Battlegroup Shatter the enemy’s willpower with airstrikes, suppression and superior infantry tactics. Devastating heavy weapons will destroy anything that remains standing. Use unorthodox Terror Tactics such as field interrogations, the Stuka’s iconic Jericho Trumpet, or V1 Rocket Strikes to force the enemy from the field, or show the enemy no quarter with Weapon Superiority and the King Tiger heavy tank. British Forces – Canadian Shock Battlegroup Seize territory to gain unparalleled momentum on the battlefield, and deploy powerful incendiary weapons to displace any who dare deny your movement. Call upon Canadian Shock Sections and aggressive battlefield tactics to secure ground in a Shock Assault, or deny the enemy what they stubbornly refuse to cede with Incendiary Weapons, including the indefatigable Churchill Crocodile. Afrikakorps – Panzerjäger Kommand Battlegroup Cripple the enemy’s advance with defensive obstacles, enabling powerful anti-armor weapons to make the killing blow. Use Stalling tactics, including Roadblocks, Minefields and Defensive Positions to buy the time you need to deploy your forces; elite Tank Busters and Tank Hunting tactics including the Elefant Tank Destroyer will crush even the strongest enemy armor.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: Company of Heroes 3: Fire and Steel是一款戰鬥群DLC包，由四個戰鬥群組成，可用於多人遊戲並在合作/遭遇戰模式對抗AI。 美國軍隊–重型武器戰鬥群 在重型裝甲部隊到達並結束戰鬥之前，用精良的小隊武器和半履帶車控制戰場。 徵調.50口徑重機槍或地圖外的毀滅性黑龍榴彈炮轟炸作為武器小組支援的一部分，或者呼叫騎兵，搭配突擊半履帶車、3英吋牽引式反坦克炮和無情的M26潘興重型坦克。 國防軍–恐懼戰鬥群 利用空襲、壓制和優越的步兵戰術來粉碎敵人的意志。毀滅性的重型武器將摧毀一切屹立不倒的東西。 使用非傳統的恐懼戰術，例如戰地審問、斯圖卡標誌性的耶利哥號角或V1火箭攻擊，將敵人趕出戰場，或利用武器優勢和虎王重型坦克毫不留情攻向敵人。 英國軍隊–加拿大突擊戰鬥群 奪取領地以在戰場上獲得無與倫比的動能，並部署強大的燃燒武器來驅逐任何膽敢阻止你行進的人。 召喚加拿大突擊隊和積極的戰場戰術，在衝擊性突擊中確保陣地安全，或用燃燒武器（包括不知疲倦的邱吉爾鱷魚坦克）剝奪頑固敵人拒絕讓出的一切東西。 非洲軍團–坦克殺手指揮部戰鬥群 利用防禦障礙物阻止敵人前進，使用強大的反裝甲武器給予致命一擊。 使用拖延戰術，包括路障、雷區和防禦陣地來爭取部署部隊所需的時間；精銳的坦克破壞者和坦克獵殺戰術，包括了象式驅逐戰車，將粉碎最強大的敵方裝甲部隊。

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Company of Heroes 3: Fire and Steel is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of four Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ skirmish vs AI.

US Forces – Heavy Weapons Battlegroup

Superior team weapons and halftracks control the battlefield before heavy armor arrives to finish the fight.

Requisition .50 cal heavy machine guns or off-map batteries of the devastating Black Dragon howitzer as part of Weapons Team support, or call in the Cavalry, with Assault half-track variants, 3-inch towed Anti-tank guns, and the implacable M26 Pershing heavy tank.

 

Wehrmacht – Terror Battlegroup

Use unorthodox Terror Tactics such as field interrogations, the Stuka’s iconic Jericho Trumpet, or V1 Rocket Strikes to force the enemy from the field, or show the enemy no quarter with Weapon Superiority and the King Tiger heavy tank.

 

British Forces – Canadian Shock Battlegroup

Seize territory to gain unparalleled momentum on the battlefield, and deploy powerful incendiary weapons to displace any who dare deny your movement.

Call upon Canadian Shock Sections and aggressive battlefield tactics to secure ground in a Shock Assault, or deny the enemy what they stubbornly refuse to cede with Incendiary Weapons, including the indefatigable Churchill Crocodile.

Use Stalling tactics, including Roadblocks, Minefields and Defensive Positions to buy the time you need to deploy your forces; elite Tank Busters and Tank Hunting tactics including the Elefant Tank Destroyer will crush even the strongest enemy armor.
